mission.name: Chaos at the windward mark (6 vessels)
mission.description: Five vessels beat upwind toward the same mark from a narrow, left/astern sector (roughly the same close-hauled heading, only their tack angle/speed differ), each rounding at its own staggered moment and bearing away onto the SAME new heading (south, broad reach) but at a different post-rounding speed -- plus one becalmed/dead-in-the-water vessel sitting at the mark itself. Busier than IMP11 -- a 5th, faster boat closing from further abeam means the approach lane is occupied for longer before any rounding even starts. Correct: Rule 8 -- a single holistic plan re-checked as each vessel rounds, not a per-contact reaction.
pass_criteria: Own-ship avoids collision with all 6 contacts.
